nodes.text:
Precautions to Prevent HMPV

Precautions to Prevent HMPV

1. Wash hands regularly with soap and water.
2. Wear masks in crowded or poorly ventilated areas.
3. Avoid close contact with sick individuals.
4. Disinfect frequently touched surfaces regularly.

nodes.author: haseenmmahim
nodes.text:
5. Cover your mouth and nose while coughing or sneezing.
6. Stay home if you feel unwell.
7. Maintain a healthy diet, exercise, and sleep routine.
8. Seek medical advice for persistent symptoms(the most important one other than precautions)
